notes: Hide Uniswap v3/v4 LP cards with zero liquidity and zero claimable amounts.
Display verified partial LP subtotal in Connected assets instead of an empty placeholder, clearly marked partial when v4 indexer is unavailable.

Sync a verified partial estimate into the existing finance wallet in its original currency, tagging the wallet cryptoPartial and remembering last synced amount; protect manual balances higher than the estimate.
No fake income or expense events and no double counting of already withdrawn fees.
Tests for partial balance flags, wallet synchronization, protection of manual overrides, and no extra finance ledger entries.
Bybit.com integration: configure only the /api/finances.js function to use Vercel Frankfurt region rather than default US API egress.
Bybit failures now expose safe, actionable diagnostics for HTTP403 regional restrictions, invalid keys, signatures, read-only permissions, API IP allowlists and rate limits.
Mask the Bybit API Key input on screen; never log upstream error bodies or save rejected credentials.
Additional tests cover masked credentials, HTTP status diagnostics, Bybit V5 retCodes, and route-specific region configuration.
versionPolicy: Крупное обновление: следующий целый номер. Мелкое обновление: следующий десятичный номер. Один пакет изменений = один production deploy.
